M-WEAR-SHELL.Name: Wear Shell
M-WEAR-SHELL.Purpose: Wear OS circular Compose UI, recording list, progress display, and manual transfer controls.

M-ANDROID-PLATFORM.Name: Android Platform Adapters
M-ANDROID-PLATFORM.Purpose: MediaStore recording discovery, non-privileged content access, and stability checks.

M-TRANSFER-CORE.Name: Portable Transfer Engine
M-TRANSFER-CORE.Purpose: Shared Rust streaming sender, incremental SHA-256 chunker, reconciliation state machine, and cancellation.

M-DISCOVERY.Name: Network Discovery and Binding
M-DISCOVERY.Purpose: Wear OS Wi-Fi network acquisition, process network socket binding, and bounded NSD/mDNS discovery.

M-PAIRING-SECURITY.Name: Pairing and Transport Security
M-PAIRING-SECURITY.Purpose: One-time PIN pairing, HMAC authentication tokens, rate-limited guessing defense, replay filtering, and peer registry.

M-WINDOWS-RECEIVER.Name: Windows Receiver Service
M-WINDOWS-RECEIVER.Purpose: Windows local HTTPS transfer service, staging file store, and crash-safe chunk journaling.

M-TRANSFER-REGISTRY.Name: Transfer Registry
M-TRANSFER-REGISTRY.Purpose: Durable transfer metadata ledger, manifest tracking, received chunk intervals, and commit status.

M-DESKTOP-UI.Name: Desktop UI Shell
M-DESKTOP-UI.Purpose: Windows Compose Desktop UI presentation, pairing management, destination selection, and history viewer.

M-ENERGY-POLICY.Name: Energy and Lifecycle Policy
M-ENERGY-POLICY.Purpose: Quiescent idle state enforcement, bounded session timeouts, immediate resource release on completion or error.

DF-RECORDING-MANIFEST.Name: Recording Manifest Flow
DF-RECORDING-MANIFEST.Purpose: Discovery of completed recordings and serialization of size, timestamp, and SHA-256 manifest.

DF-DISCOVERY-AND-PAIRING.Name: Discovery and Pairing Flow
DF-DISCOVERY-AND-PAIRING.Purpose: NSD/mDNS discovery of receiver endpoint followed by one-time code pairing and mutual secret establishment.

DF-ENCRYPTED-CHUNK-UPLOAD.Name: Encrypted Chunk Upload Flow
DF-ENCRYPTED-CHUNK-UPLOAD.Purpose: Streaming upload of bounded audio chunks over authenticated Wi-Fi transport.

DF-DURABLE-CHECKPOINT.Name: Durable Checkpoint Flow
DF-DURABLE-CHECKPOINT.Purpose: Journaling of chunk acknowledgements and atomic finalization of received recording.

DF-LIFECYCLE-CLEANUP.Name: Lifecycle Cleanup Flow
DF-LIFECYCLE-CLEANUP.Purpose: Immediate release of Wi-Fi requests, sockets, wakelocks, and cancellation handles on completion or error.
